headline: When Is It Time to Upgrade Your Commercial Water Heater?
articleBody: A reliable supply of hot water is absolutely critical for many businesses, from restaurants needing sanitization to hotels serving guests. But how do you know when it’s time to upgrade your commercial water heater before it completely gives out? One major sign is its age; if your unit is more than 8-10 years old, its efficiency is likely declining, and it's nearing the end of its lifespan. You might notice inconsistent hot water supply, or perhaps it's simply not keeping up with demand anymore, leading to cold showers for guests or inadequate sanitation in your kitchen. Rising energy bills are another key indicator, as older units tend to be less energy-efficient. Any leaks around the base of the tank, rust-colored water, or strange noises coming from the unit are urgent red flags that it’s time for a replacement. Upgrading can mean better efficiency, more reliable hot water, and fewer headaches.
